name: Kouji Kido
source:
Human.
Star Sign: Libra
Occupation: Thief

The party's number one straight man.
He wanted to be a magician, but he only did odd jobs and ended up a thief. Even though it was a bit unwilling, he has a lot of skill.
He likes women and gets attached to the protagonist right away.
But he likes to cast illusions on girls so being liked by him can be annoying.
